source_title: OECD Making Justice Systems More Effective and People Centred 2025
direct_observation: two-thirds of the world population lack meaningful access to justice; around 600 million OECD residents cannot resolve everyday justice problems
evidence_status: high for global signal; estimate does not identify named pathway or outcome
next_test: link legal need to service entry, resolution and household result

source_title: OECD Toolkit for Access to Justice 2025
direct_observation: five pillars cover purpose/culture, service design, governance, empowerment and evidence-based planning; services should be affordable, inclusive and responsive
evidence_status: high for design architecture; implementation and user outcomes remain open
next_test: audit one service for language, disability, cost, feedback and remedy

direct_observation: social-security, land/housing and financial problems dominate; many use mahalla first; only 8.6% can afford a lawyer
evidence_status: high for bounded national case; transferability and final resolution remain open
next_test: follow named need through community advice, legal aid, decision and enforcement

unit_or_scope: six Indian states and marginalized groups
direct_observation: legal-aid delivery gaps vary by location, gender, caste, tribe, religion, disability and migration; mixed methods map formal and informal pathways
evidence_status: high for intersectional access boundary; case outcomes and recurrence remain open
next_test: compare subgroup route, cost, representation, decision, enforcement and stability

direct_observation: legal-aid coverage is uneven; awareness is low and government and CSO provision leaves counties underserved
evidence_status: medium-to-high for supply and awareness gap; user-level resolution remains open
next_test: follow requests from awareness to approval, counsel, outcome and enforcement

unit_or_scope: informal intermediaries and formal justice systems
direct_observation: local intermediaries and people-centred services can lower complexity, but informal routes may reproduce power gaps
evidence_status: medium; pathway and safeguard mechanism is clear, durable equality remains open
next_test: measure user choice, safety, fairness, remedy and recurrence across formal/informal routes
